role: Declares the block-as-item model (RenderBlocks.renderBlockAsItem geometry in block-local space) used by the GUI slot, held-item and dropped-item renderers. Also block_item_model_grass_color; chest_texture is 1 normal, 2 ender, 3 trapped.

structs.name: block_item_quad
structs.java: one Tessellator quad emitted by renderBlockAsItem (position, UV, normal, grass-top tint flag)

notes: Fixed-capacity quad array (192). No test includes it directly; exercised through the pixel gates of raster_hud.c, raster_hand.c and raster_entities.c (not verified which golden frames).
